Searched for Mount Seattle Noyes Basin from Low Divide. Results were SummitPost 2010 Christie/Noyes/Meany reports (403), a Mazamas activity page about Seattle Creek basin and the Noyes-Seattle ridge (a different line), and Lists of John stats. No open page describes ascending Mount Seattle through Noyes Basin with times or figures.

Searched for West Twin Needle from the Himmelhorn notch. Hits were Abegg's Twin Needles report (from Eye Col, a different line), a 2018 Southern Pickets enchainment report on CascadeClimbers (403) calling West Twin easy third class as part of a traverse, an AAC article on a Himmelhorn notch pitch, and Holsten's traverse blog. None gives a standalone West Slope ascent with days, times or figures.

Searched for Golden Horn north and northeast routes. Only the 1958 AAJ note describes the North Face, and it gives no figures. Other hits (Lemke, Yellowleaf, WTA, Mountaineers) cover the standard south-side scramble from Snowy Lakes. No second source.

Searched for Golden Horn NE Arete 5.8. The one route report (skisickness 2011, including its ?view=print URL) still returns 404. Alpinist covers a different new route on Golden Horn. Snippets confirm the 1979 Skoog-Walseth first ascent and that the climb is loose, but no opened page describes the arete's day.

Searched for the Hozomeen South Peak SE Buttress via Willow Lake. The 1989 AAJ first-ascent report is still the only account, and it gives no descent or exit. Wikipedia lists only grade and FA party, and it places the route under the Southwest sub-peak, which conflicts with the row. The SummitPost and CascadeClimbers pages for the south peaks return 403. No second source.

Searched for The Incisor in Royal Basin. Every hit was another Incisor (Combatant Mountain BC, Montana, Australia), and the one Olympic report is on CascadeClimbers (403). No open source.

Stevensong's Tooth page was opened but holds no route text in its index. Snippets say the north side is a class 3-4 scramble used mostly as a descent, but no opened page describes ascending it with times or figures.

The SummitPost route page and the 2010 CascadeClimbers East Couloir / North Ridge report both return 403, and turns-all-year's hit is a ski of a different Whistler.
